discordPostHtml:
a purposefully overpowered system near the core worlds that should contain everything you need to create a thriving set of colonies to do whatever you want with

if you don't like any of the planets in this mod you can change them yourself because this mod was written in notepad

(removed all unknown skies stuff and industrial evolution stuff because those mods aren't updated yet)
(also does not include any potentially new content added in the recent update because uhhh i havent looked at it yet)

download here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kBhe_7hs1EEmeY8LMd6RwHSsaitGTqui/view
